# Six cooperative contact branches

`cooperative.tsv` observes original `touchEffects2` BLUE, YELLOW, ROSE, MINT, LAVENDER, and MAGENTA methods.
Two actual source runs and the bundled JAR produce identical bytes.
All five compiled helper classes also match.
No Rust output supplies an expected value or a constructor input.

The fixed scope contains 206 cases, 618 snapshots, 412 calls, 1,884 actor views, and thirty actual newborns.
The 206 tree-building calls preserve the real source spatial ordering.
Actual contacts comprise MAGENTA 79, MINT 40, LAVENDER 25, ROSE 17, YELLOW 35, and BLUE 10.

Compare nongeometric values, gas, statistics, raw ARGB, bounds, RNG, object references, and order exactly.
Only the existing organism `_m`, `_m1`, `_m2`, `_mass`, and `_I` fields retain geometric tolerance.
For finite geometry, that tolerance is `1e-10 * max(1, abs(expected))`.
Check geometric NaN classification and signed infinity explicitly.
The named organism collaborators are `_world` and `_visibleWorld`.
World exclusions are `_visibleWorld`, `inCorridors`, `outCorridors`, and `_corridorexists`.
These exclusions and selection metadata do not claim UI or networking coverage.

The observer preserves the Coral corpus's actual construction and dynamic discovery protocol.
Initial recipes are `g0`, `g1`, `g2`, and `g3` explicit, with `g4` cloned from `g0`.
The source creates real `VisibleWorld(null)` and World objects without invoking genesis or frames.
It adds selector, victim, and killer at `(1000,1000)`, `(3500,3500)`, and `(5000,5000)`.
Their initial IDs are zero, one, and two.
Selection precedes the first add and avoids unrelated MainWindow callbacks.

Every case resets actual defaults and records all 147 mutable primitive settings before constructing actors.
The setup seed is `827364`; initial attempts are zero and initial oxygen is `1000`.
Mutation bounds are `0..10000`, meta mutation is zero, and supplied code mutation rates are zero.
GREEN selection weight is seven; other selectable weights are zero.
Ordinary codes contain one length-twelve gene, symmetry one, and mirror zero.
Generation is 41, clade is `root`, and spore/adaptation modifiers are one.
Explicit cases supply multiple recipient genes before construction.

Every later control appears as a typed `I` row before its actual operation.
The frozen input inventory contains 62 distinct targets.
Array controls must match actual organism segment counts.
Observed outputs never become setup inputs.
The exact labelled ARGB is checked before reflecting into original `touchEffects2(Organism,int,int)`.

The helper discovers newborns from actual World member identity.
`D` rows bind their actual IDs and genome references.
Full O154/H3 observations retain every known organism after each operation.
Full W10/V15, statistics S52/T49, spatial J/Q, G28/N40, and nonconsuming RNG suffixes remain recorded.
`Y` identifies live genotype availability through organism, supplied-code, and statistics roots.
All 3,117 recorded genotype scopes are observable; no rejected candidate is present.
Per-Gene mutable-object alias topology remains the separate genetics corpus's obligation.

The MAGENTA sweep covers all 46 base colors, eighteen internal colors, unknown ARGB, and translucent MAGENTA.
Other baseline cases cover their distinct peer dispatch groups.
Targeted cases exercise actual Yellow births, blocked placement, shields, antiviral cleanup, strict thresholds, and wrapped child counts.
Rose cases distinguish integer division from floating division.
Mint cases cover code identity, separate partial payments, neutralization, Blue protection, and inactive spore rewrites.
Lavender cases cover ignored colors, altruist gates, wrapping, and truncated timer arithmetic.
Magenta cases preserve partial healing, restored injury caches, and later failed payments.
Nonfinite runtime energy and oxygen remain source inputs, without additional tolerances.

Compile `tools/reference/CooperativeOracle.java` against each pinned backend.
Run `biogenesis.CooperativeOracle NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY` using the provenance's isolated profile arguments.
The helper validates all four profile roots through `toRealPath` and refuses existing outputs.
Actual positive runs have a 120-second limit; six negative guard runs have a 30-second limit.
The existing runner cleans its owned process group.
Six guards cover each missing root, an escaping profile symlink, and existing-output preservation.
All 74 source hash/size/mode pins and thirty prior TSV fixtures remain unchanged.

This corpus does not execute physical eligibility, complete frames, player controls, persistence, or networking.
Its controlled method states do not assert natural gameplay reachability or complete color-matrix coverage.
Java provenance does not claim a Rust replay result.
